subject: Kickoff: DP-SGD clipping library hardening
body:
Hi Santiago, Umar,

Kicking off the clipping-library effort for the efficiency portfolio. Today every internal DP training pipeline pays the per-example gradient memory tax; our open-source release gives three fast, memory-efficient clipping algorithms for conv models — in-place direct norm, ghost norm, and an FFT-based norm — plus a selector (grad_norm_computation_selector) that picks per layer configuration since none of the three dominates.

Product goal: a hardened internal package that the DP pipelines adopt as a drop-in, with a benchmark report they can cite. OKR framing is "cut DP-SGD training memory overhead by 40% for conv workloads."

Milestones: API freeze end of March, benchmark matrix across our standard conv architectures by mid-May, adoption by two pipelines before Q3 OKR lock (June 26).

Santiago — staffing and compute next, please.

Zofia
